title_en: GameCube Classic Star Fox Adventures Available Via Nintendo Switch Online Today
summary_en: Underappreciated GameCube classic Star Fox Adventures will arrive on Nintendo Switch 2 today, as part of the Nintendo Switch Online + Expansion Pack subscription.
body_en:
Underappreciated GameCube classic Star Fox Adventures will arrive on Nintendo Switch 2 today, as part of the Nintendo Switch Online + Expansion Pack subscription.
Originally launched back in 2002, this adventure game raised eyebrows at the time for ditching the Star Fox franchise's usual vehicle-based shooting for something more akin to a Zelda title. But it's become something of a cult favorite in the years since, and some fans really like the character of Krystal, introduced to the series here for the first time.
Star Fox Adventures is landing on Nintendo GameCube – Nintendo Classics later today!
Alongside his pal Tricky, Fox explores a planet populated by dinosaurs, but who knows what they might uncover? #NintendoDirect pic.twitter.com/iie3IPeKlT
In other Star Fox news, Nintendo has announced a free update coming to this year's Star Fox Switch 2 game. Soon you'll be able to play in four-player battles across three additional stages. This update is coming later this month, on September 29.
Catch up on all of the big announcements in our roundup of everything announced in today's Nintendo Direct broadcast , as well as everything announced in The Legend of Zelda Nintendo Direct that aired yesterday.
Tom Phillips is IGN's News Editor. You can reach Tom at tom_phillips@ign.com or find him on Bluesky @tomphillipseg.bsky.social
